frameworks.primary_purpose: Agricultural resource planning, crop suitability zoning, and regional public investment targeting

frameworks.name: Agro-Ecological Regionalization
frameworks.institution: National Bureau of Soil Survey & Land Use Planning (ICAR-NBSS&LUP)

acz_regions.name: Western Himalayan Region
acz_regions.soil: Skeletal, mountain, hill soils, podzolic and meadow soils
acz_regions.physiography: Lofty Himalayan mountain ranges, deep valleys, high relief, alpine pastures (margs/dhoks) above 2000m
acz_regions.lgp_days: Short (90–150 days in valley floors; <90 days in cold arid alpine Ladakh)
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Transhumance rearing of sheep and goats by Gujjar and Gaddi pastoralists in alpine pastures
acz_regions.water_resources: Drained by perennial rivers (Indus, Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, Sutlej, Ganga, Yamuna) with abundant snowmelt
constraints: Rugged mountain topography with steep slopes
Severe cold and frost in winter
Severe soil erosion and landslides
Inaccessible terrain and transport bottlenecks
development_strategies: Water harvesting in hillside ponds
Terrace stabilization and contour bunding
Expansion of temperate horticulture and post-harvest cold chains
Promotion of off-season vegetables and floriculture

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Eastern Himalayan Region
acz_regions.soil: Red-brown, brown forest soils and lateritic soils, generally acidic and less fertile on steep slopes
acz_regions.physiography: Rugged eastern Himalayan ranges, Patkai/Purvanchal hill tracts, steep gorges, dense subtropical/temperate forests
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Livestock and piggery integrated with traditional jhum/shifting cultivation
acz_regions.water_resources: Brahmaputra and swift Himalayan tributaries (Teesta, Manas, Subansiri, Barak) with heavy monsoon runoff
constraints: Widespread shifting (Jhum) cultivation causing soil degradation and forest loss
Heavy rainfall causing acute soil erosion on slopes
Frequent flash floods in foothill valleys
Poor market connectivity and processing infrastructure
development_strategies: Gradual transition from jhuming to settled terrace cultivation and agro-forestry
Encouraging high-value organic horticulture (spices, citrus, tea)
Development of sericulture, poultry, and bamboo-based cottage industries
Check runoff and soil erosion through vegetative contour barriers

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Lower Gangetic Plain Region
acz_regions.soil: Rich alluvial soil, clayey saline soils in deltaic margins, laterite in western fringe
acz_regions.physiography: Extremely gentle low-gradient alluvial delta and floodplain, oxbow lakes, river meanders, tidal estuaries
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Pisciculture (inland riverine, pond fish and brackish water prawn culture) and dairying
acz_regions.water_resources: Ganga delta, Hooghly, Damodar, Mayurakshi, dense network of canals and high shallow water table
constraints: Poor drainage, seasonal waterlogging, and extensive marshy bils/taals
Flood inundation during peak monsoon
Soil salinity ingress in lower Sunderbans delta
development_strategies: Intensification of Boro (summer) rice and high-yield rabi crops
Pisciculture integration (rice-fish farming)
Expansion of cold storages for potato and perishable vegetables
Drainage improvement and flood-proof embankments

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Middle Gangetic Plain Region
acz_regions.soil: Fertile alluvial soils, sandy loam to clayey loam, Khadar (newer) and Bhangar (older) alluvium
acz_regions.physiography: Gently sloping vast plain formed by the depositional work of the Ganga, Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi and Son rivers
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Cattle and buffalo rearing, dairying, and inland riverine fishery
acz_regions.water_resources: Ganga, Gandak, Kosi, Ghaghara, Sone rivers; extensive tube wells and state canal systems
constraints: Recurring devastating floods in North Bihar (Kosi 'Sorrow of Bihar')
High population pressure resulting in small, fragmented landholdings
Underutilization of groundwater potential in eastern UP
development_strategies: Crop diversification into horticulture and high-value vegetables
Water management and flood control in North Bihar plains
Promotion of agro-forestry, silviculture, and dairy cooperatives
Expansion of tube well electrification for assured irrigation

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Upper Gangetic Plain Region
acz_regions.soil: Deep, fertile alluvial soils, sandy loam to loam, with calcareous patches
acz_regions.physiography: Smooth alluvial plain encompassing the fertile Ganga-Yamuna Doab, Rohilkhand, and Lucknow divisions
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Intensive dairy farming and livestock rearing integrated with crop agriculture
acz_regions.water_resources: Upper and Lower Ganga Canals, Eastern Yamuna Canal, dense tube well network
constraints: Soil salinization and alkalinization (usar/reh soils) due to canal over-irrigation
Falling groundwater tables in tube well concentrated belts
Sugarcane monoculture stressing water resources
development_strategies: Reclamation of saline/alkali soils using gypsum and green manuring
Promotion of drip irrigation and water-saving in sugarcane
Encouraging mixed cropping, vegetable clusters, and floriculture
Modernization of canal distribution networks to reduce transmission losses

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Trans Gangetic Plain Region
acz_regions.avgann_rf: 40 cm To 100 cm (DBF: 065 cm To 125 cm)
acz_regions.soil: Productive alluvial soil, sandy loam, calcareous arid alluvium in south-west
acz_regions.physiography: Flat to gently undulating alluvial plain drained by the Sutlej, Beas, and Ghaggar river systems
acz_regions.lgp_days: 90–150 days (Semi-arid continental; heavily supplemented by year-round irrigation)
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Advanced dairy farming (Murrah buffaloes, Sahiwal cattle), poultry, and agro-processing
acz_regions.water_resources: Bhakra Nangal, Western Yamuna, and Sirhind canals; widespread deep submersible tube wells
constraints: Alarming groundwater depletion (overexploited aquifers in >80% blocks)
Paddy stubble (parali) burning causing severe air pollution
Secondary soil salinization and micronutrient deficiencies (zinc, sulfur)
Paddy-wheat monoculture fatigue
development_strategies: Direct Seeding of Rice (DSR) and Happy Seeder in-situ residue management
Crop diversification away from summer paddy to maize, pulses, and oilseeds
Strict regulation of groundwater extraction and micro-irrigation subsidies
Cultivation of high-value vegetables in the vicinity of industrial and urban clusters

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Eastern Plateau & Hills Region
acz_regions.avgann_rf: 75 cm To 150 cm (DBF: 080 cm To 150 cm)
acz_regions.soil: Red and yellow soils, laterite soils on plateaus, mixed with gravelly hill soils
acz_regions.physiography: Chotanagpur plateau, Garhjat hills, Rajmahal hills, Dandakaranya, undulating terrain with rocky outcrops
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Livestock rearing in forested upland pastures, lac cultivation, sericulture (Tasar silk)
acz_regions.water_resources: Mahanadi, Damodar, Subarnarekha, Brahmani; surface runoff is high due to steep slopes and hard crystalline rocks
constraints: Deficiency in perennial surface water and low groundwater recharge due to hard rock terrain
High soil acidity, low phosphorus availability, and steep slope erosion
Predominance of rainfed monocropping with high drought vulnerability
development_strategies: Watershed management, check dams, and hillside rainwater harvesting (5% model)
Introduction of drought-hardy HYV seed varieties and pulses/oilseeds
Expansion of agro-forestry, horticultural orchards, and tribal non-timber forest product value addition
Soil liming to correct high soil acidity

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Central Plateau & Hills Region
acz_regions.soil: Mixed red and black soils, shallow black soil, sandy alluvium in river valleys
acz_regions.physiography: Bundelkhand upland, Baghelkhand, Bhander plateau, Malwa plateau, Vindhyachal and Satpura ranges
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Extensive cattle, goat, and sheep grazing; rural dairying
acz_regions.water_resources: Chambal, Betwa, Ken, Narmada, Son rivers; non-perennial seasonal tributaries
constraints: Chronic water scarcity and frequent droughts (Bundelkhand drought syndrome)
Severe ravine formation and gully erosion along Chambal and Yamuna basins
Shallow soil depth with low moisture retention in rocky uplands
development_strategies: Water conservation via farm ponds, percolation tanks, check dams, and micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler)
Adoption of dryland farming packages and drought-resistant pulse/oilseed cultivars
Reclamation and stabilization of Chambal ravines through afforestation and bamboo planting
Dairy and goat rearing development as risk-hedging enterprise

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Western Plateau & Hills Region
acz_regions.avgann_rf: 25 cm To 75 cm (DBF: 050 cm To 100 cm)
acz_regions.soil: Black cotton soil (Regur soil) derived from Deccan basalt trap, medium to deep vertisols
acz_regions.physiography: Deccan lava plateau, Sahyadri rain-shadow uplands, undulating plains of Godavari, Bhima, and Krishna
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Cooperative dairying, poultry farming, and sheep rearing
acz_regions.water_resources: Upper Godavari, Bhima, Krishna rivers; heavily dependent on wells and storage dams
constraints: Rain-shadow dryland vulnerability; only ~12-15% cultivated area has assured irrigation
Water-intensive crops (sugarcane) depleting regional water balances in drought-prone Marathwada/Vidarbha
Deep cracking in vertisols during dry periods; waterlogging when saturated
development_strategies: Universal adoption of water-saving micro-irrigation (drip mandatory for sugarcane)
Restructuring cropping pattern towards coarse grains (Jowar, Bajra) and drought-tolerant pulses
Watershed development and watershed-scale contour trenching
Strengthening dryland horticulture and cold storage logistics

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Southern Plateau & Hills Region
acz_regions.soil: Red loamy soils, red sandy soils, mixed red and black soils
acz_regions.physiography: Deccan peninsular plateau, Telangana plateau, Rayalaseema, Karnataka plateau, Mysore plateau, Eastern Ghats ridges
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Sheep, goat, and dairy cattle rearing; poultry farming (Namakkal poultry belt)
acz_regions.water_resources: Krishna, Tungabhadra, Pennar, Kaveri rivers; extensive historical tank irrigation systems
constraints: Semi-arid climate with high evapotranspiration and frequent droughts in Rayalaseema and North Karnataka
Depletion of groundwater and siltation of traditional irrigation tanks
Coarse-textured red soils with low moisture-holding capacity
development_strategies: Restoration and de-silting of traditional village cascade tanks (e.g. Mission Kakatiya)
Promotion of drought-resilient millets (Shree Anna: Ragi, Jowar) and oilseeds
Micro-irrigation and precision farming in horticulture and commercial crops
Poultry and livestock integration with dryland farming systems

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: East Coast Plains & Hills Region
acz_regions.soil: Alluvial, coastal sands, deltaic clay, loam, with patches of alkaline soils
acz_regions.physiography: Coastal plain along the Bay of Bengal extending from Northern Circars to the Coromandel Coast and Kanniyakumari, dominated by extensive deltas
acz_regions.lgp_days: 150–210 days (Subhumid marine; bimodal rainfall with heavy North-East Monsoon in south)
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Brackish water aquaculture (shrimp/prawn farming), marine and deltaic capture fisheries, poultry
acz_regions.water_resources: Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, and Kaveri deltas; extensive canal systems and coastal lagoons (Chilika, Pulicat)
constraints: Recurrent severe tropical cyclones and storm surges from the Bay of Bengal
Coastal salinity ingress and alkaline soil degradation in delta tails
Failure or irregularity of the North-East Monsoon in the Coromandel tract
development_strategies: Discouraging monoculture of paddy and promoting crop diversification into pulses and oilseeds
Construction of shelterbelts, mangrove restoration, and cyclone-resilient farm infrastructure
Scientific regulation of aquaculture to prevent salinization of adjoining freshwater aquifers
Improvement in drainage networks to alleviate monsoon coastal waterlogging

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: West Coast Plains & Ghats Region
acz_regions.avgann_rf: 200 cm To 400 cm (Exceeds 200 cm across region; >300 cm on Ghat slopes)
acz_regions.soil: Laterite soils on terraces and hills, rich alluvial soils in river valleys and coastal strips
acz_regions.physiography: Narrow coastal plain (Konkan, Kanara, Malabar) flanked by the steep escarpment of the Western Ghats (Sahyadris)
major_crops: Spices (Black Pepper, Cardamom, Clove, Nutmeg, Cinnamon)
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Dairy farming, duck farming in backwaters, deep-sea marine fisheries, brackish water aquaculture (pokkali rice-fish systems)
acz_regions.water_resources: Numerous short, swift west-flowing rivers (Zuari, Mandovi, Sharavathi, Netravati, Periyar, Bharatapuzha), backwaters (kayals)
constraints: Severe soil acidity, intense nutrient leaching, and rapid runoff due to torrential rainfall
Soil erosion and frequent landslides along the Western Ghats escarpment
Small, fragmented home-garden holdings with high labor costs
development_strategies: Multi-tier home-garden agroforestry systems combining spices, coconut, and fruit trees
Value addition and geographical indication (GI) branding for plantation and spice crops
Upgrading drainage and coastal protection against sea erosion
Expansion of eco-friendly brackish water prawn and cage fish culture

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Gujarat Plains & Hills Region
acz_regions.soil: Regur (black) soils in plateau tracts, alluvial soils in central/coastal plains, red and yellow soils in Jamnagar, sandy arid soils in northern fringe
acz_regions.physiography: Kathiawar peninsula (Saurashtra), fertile plains of Mahi, Sabarmati, and Narmada, Girnar and Kutch uplands, Rann salt flats
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Pioneering cooperative dairy industry (AMUL / Anand Model), Gir and Kankrej cattle rearing, coastal fishing
acz_regions.water_resources: Sardar Sarovar Dam (Narmada Canal Project), Sabarmati, Mahi, Tapi, deep tube wells in North Gujarat
constraints: Low and erratic rainfall with frequent drought cycles in Saurashtra and Kutch
Severe groundwater salinity and seawater intrusion in coastal aquifers
Fluoride contamination and deep water table exhaustion
development_strategies: Comprehensive surface water management via Sardar Sarovar canal network and check dams (Sujalam Sufalam)
Rainwater harvesting and artificial groundwater recharge wells
Expansion of drip/micro-irrigation for cash crops (cotton, groundnut, castor)
Marine aquaculture and value addition in coastal zones

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Western Dry Region
states: Rajasthan (Western 9 districts west of Aravallis: Jaisalmer, Bikaner, Barmer, Jodhpur, Nagaur, Churu, etc.)
acz_regions.soil: Desert soils, sandy soils with low organic matter, high alkalinity, shifting dunes
acz_regions.physiography: Thar Desert, shifting sand dunes (dhrians), flat playa depressions, arid plains west of the Aravalli range
acz_regions.lgp_days: Extremely short (<90 days; typically 60–80 days under rainfed conditions)
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Nomadic and semi-nomadic pastoralism: camel, sheep (Marwari, Chokla wool), and Tharparkar cattle rearing
acz_regions.water_resources: Indira Gandhi Canal (IGNP) bringing Himalayan waters from Harike Barrage; traditional rainwater kunds/tankas
constraints: Extreme aridity, sparse and unreliable rainfall, and scorching summer temperatures up to 48-50°C
Severe wind erosion and shifting sand dunes engulfing farmlands
Waterlogging and secondary soil salinization in canal command areas due to impermeable gypsum hardpan
development_strategies: Water management and prevention of waterlogging in the Indira Gandhi Canal command area
Shelterbelt plantation, sand dune stabilization with Acacia tortilis and Cenchrus ciliaris grass
Promotion of drought-hardy pulses (Moth, Guar) and Shree Anna millets (Bajra)
Adoption of solar-powered drip irrigation and desert greenhouse farming

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

acz_regions.name: Island region
acz_regions.soil: Sandy along coral coast, to clayey loam in valleys and lower slopes, rich in organic matter
acz_regions.physiography: Archipelagos in Bay of Bengal (Andaman & Nicobar: submerged volcanic/folded mountain crests) and Arabian Sea (Lakshadweep: coral atolls)
acz_regions.lgp_days: Perhumid (>300 days; uniform equatorial maritime climate)
acz_regions.pastoral_activities: Deep-sea tuna and oceanic pelagic fisheries, crab and lobster farming, poultry and piggery
acz_regions.water_resources: Heavy equatorial monsoon precipitation; absence of large rivers; dependent on freshwater lens and rain harvesting
constraints: Geographic isolation, high logistics and shipping costs to mainland markets
Ecologically fragile coral reefs, island biodiversity, and vulnerability to sea-level rise and tsunamis
Limited arable land availability with strict forest conservation mandates
development_strategies: Multi-purpose deep-sea fishing fleet development and cold chain processing for oceanic tuna export
Value addition to organic coconut (virgin coconut oil, coir, desiccated coconut)
Expansion of high-value shade spices (vanilla, black pepper, nutmeg) in coconut groves
Rainwater harvesting and solar desalination for island water security

source_attribution.literature_source: e-PG Pathshala Module RG-38 & UPSC Study Material

aez_regions.raw_physio: EASTERN GHATS AND TAMIL NADU UPLANDS AND DECCAN (K ARNATAKA) PLATEAU  HOT SEMI-ARID ECO-REGION

aez_regions.physiography: Upper and Middle Indo-Gangetic Plain

aez_regions.raw_physio: CENTRAL HIGHLANDS (MALWA AND BUNDELKHAND)  HOT SUBHUMID (DRY) ECO-REGION
aez_regions.physiography: Central Highlands (Malwa, Bundelkhand, Vindhyan scarplands)

aez_regions.physiography: Chotanagpur Plateau and Garhjat Hills

aez_regions.raw_physio: ISLANDS  OF ANDAMAN-NICOBAR  AND LAKSHADWEEP  HOT  HUMID  TO PERHUMID ISLAND ECO REGION
aez_regions.physiography: Oceanic Islands (Andaman & Nicobar ridges, Lakshadweep atolls)
constraints: Vulnerability to sea surges, coastal erosion, coral reef fragility
